description: Crop linked or embedded images to a rectangle, discarding the pixels outside it (Object > Crop Image). The result is an embedded image at the given resolution; a linked file is embedded, as Crop Image does

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

bounds.description: The area to keep, in points from the artboard's top-left corner

resolution.description: Pixels per inch of the cropped image. Default 300; list_images gives each image's current ppi

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: crop_image
title: Crop Image
